title: Notification for Battlespace Modeling and Simulation (BMS) Engineering Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVAIR.NAVAIR NAWC AD.NAVAL AIR WARFARE CENTER AIR DIV
detail_text: NOTICE: ALL INFORMATION PRESENTED IS CONSIDERED DRAFT AND NOT FINAL UNTIL THE RELEASE OF THE FINAL SOLICITATION. THIS IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES TO AID INDUSTRY IN UNDERSTANDING THE INTENT OF THE GOVERNMENT WITH REGARDS TO THE ANTICIPATED PROCUREMENT. The notification shares the questions submitted by industry and the corresponding Government responses regarding the DRAFT Performance Work Statement (PWS) for the anticipated procurement related to NAWCAD Battlespace Modeling and Simulation Engineering Services Notification of Intent/Sources Sought Notice ID: N00421-25-RFPREQ-54000MA-0059. The Government encourages the submission of constructive feedback on the anticipated procurement from all potential Offerors, including those interested in subcontracting opportunities, to Contract Specialist, Karen Joachim, at karen.v.joachim.civ@us.navy.mil. The Government appreciates industry engagement and will take all suggestions under advisement.
